args.subject: Group booking inquiry - 10 people in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I am writing to inquire about availability for a group stay of 10 people in June. We are interested in booking accommodations at your hotel and would like to know about room options, rates, and any group-specific amenities or requirements.

Could you please provide information on availability for June dates, as well as any special group booking policies or discounts that may apply?

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
